title: Te Tohu i waenganui i ngā Kōhatu
intro: I tētahi whenua i whakairohia ai ngā maunga hei kāinga, ka tae mai tētahi karere me tētahi tohu merekara mai i a Allah. I tono te iwi i tētahi tohu, ā, i riro mai i a rātou tētahi mea hanga mai i te toka totoka. Engari nā tō rātou whakapehapeha i ārahi rātou ki te whakahē i te whakatūpato, ā, i hiritia ai tō rātou aituā.
clues: I tonoa ahau ki tētahi iwi e noho ana i ngā whare i keria ki ngā maunga.
I werohia ahau kia mauria mai he tohu, nō reira i whakaputaina mai ai e ahau he kamera i te toka.
I whakahau ahau i a rātou kia inu noa te kamera, kaua hoki e whara i a ia.
Kāore rātou i whakarongo, ā, i whakangāwari hoki i te kamera, i te whakahē hoki i taku whakatūpato.
I kī atu ahau ka whiua i muri i ngā rā e toru.
I te ata, ka whakangaromia rātou e te pahū nui, engari i ora mātou ko aku akonga.

arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ ثَمُودَ أَخَاهُمْ صَـٰلِحًا أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَإِذَا هُمْ فَرِيقَانِ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verse: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Ṣāliḥ, [saying], "Worship Allāh," and at once they were two parties conflicting. (27:45)
